title: New York Governor Kathy Hochul signs RAISE Act to regulate AI safety
description: The bill will require large AI developers to publish information about their safety protocols and report safety incidents to the state within 72 hours.
author: Anthony Ha

title: Ex-Splunk execs’ startup Resolve AI hits $1 billion valuation with Series A
description: The round was led by Lightspeed Venture Partners, according to people familiar with the deal.
author: Marina Temkin

title: Cursor continues acquisition spree with Graphite deal
description: Graphite is an AI code review assistant that was last valued at $290 million.
author: Marina Temkin

title: Yann LeCun confirms his new ‘world model’ startup, reportedly seeks $5B+ valuation
description: Renowned AI scientist Yann LeCun confirmed on Thursday the worst-kept secret in the tech world: that he had indeed launched a new startup. Although he did say he will not be running the new company as its CEO.
author: Julie Bort

title: Hardware’s brutal week: iRobot, Luminar, and Rad Power go bankrupt
description: The hardware world had a brutal week, with iRobot, Luminar, and Rad Power Bikes all filing for bankruptcy.  Each company faces its own mix of tariff pressures, supply chain issues, and shifting markets, but together they tell a larger story about the challenges of building physical products in an era of global trade tensions and […]
author: Theresa Loconsolo, Anthony Ha, Rebecca Bellan, Sean O'Kane

title: OpenAI adds new teen safety rules to ChatGPT as lawmakers weigh AI standards for minors
description: OpenAI updated its guidelines for how its AI models should behave with users under 18, and published new AI literacy resources for teens and parents. Still, questions remain about how well policies translate into practice.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Known uses voice AI to help you go on more in-person dates
description: In its test phase in San Francisco, Known said it observed 80% of its introductions led to physical dates, which is much higher than swipe-based dating apps.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Meta is developing a new image and video model for a 2026 release, report says
description: Meta aims to make the text-based model better at coding while also exploring new world models that understand visual information and can reason, plan, and act without needing to be trained on every possibility.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: OpenAI is reportedly trying to raise $100B at an $830B valuation
description: The ChatGPT maker is aiming to raise the funding by the end of the first quarter in 2026, and the company may ask sovereign wealth funds to invest in the round.
author: Ram Iyer

title: From Roombas to e-bikes, why are hardware startups going bankrupt?
description: The hardware world had a brutal week, with iRobot, Luminar, and Rad Power Bikes all filing for bankruptcy.  Each company faces its own mix of tariff pressures, supply chain issues, and shifting markets, but together they tell a larger story about the challenges of building physical products in an era of global trade tensions and cheap overseas competition. From […]
author: Theresa Loconsolo

title: ChatGPT launches an app store, lets developers know it’s open for business
description: OpenAI is looking to populate its flagship chatbot with a host of new user experiences.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Pickle Robot adds Tesla veteran as first CFO
description: Jeff Evanson recently joined Pickle Robot as the company's first CFO as the startup has allegedly expanded its partnership with UPS.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Why British politicians are flocking to American tech giants
description: Former British Chancellor of the Exchequer George Osborne has joined OpenAI as managing director and head of OpenAI for Countries. He will run also Coinbase's internal advisory council.
author: Anna Heim

title: ChatGPT’s mobile app hits new milestone of $3B in consumer spending
description: ChatGPT has reached $3B in lifetime mobile consumer spending in just 31 months, faster than TikTok and major streaming apps.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Peripheral Labs taps into self-driving car sensors to bring sports fans right into the game
description: The startup has raised a $3.6 million seed round led by Khosla Ventures.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Luma releases a new AI model that lets users generate a video from a start  and end frame
description: Luma AI's new model is available through the company's Dream Machine platform.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Vibe-coding startup Lovable raises $330M at a $6.6B valuation
description: Lovable has seen its valuation more than triple just five months after the company's last funding round in July.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Amazon’s new Alexa+ feature adds conversational AI to Ring doorbells
description: Amazon said that the feature uses the Ring doorbell's video descriptions to determine who the person in front of the camera is based on their uniform, actions, and what they are holding.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Adobe hit with proposed class-action, accused of misusing authors’ work in AI training
description: The lawsuit is just the latest in a string of copyright-related legal complaints aimed at the AI industry.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Amazon appoints longtime AWS exec Peter DeSantis to lead new AI org
description: DeSantis has spent 27 years at Amazon, including eight years as an SVP for AWS, the cloud provider that powers about one-third of the internet.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Google launches Gemini 3 Flash, makes it the default model in the Gemini app
description: Google is making Gemini 3 Flash the default model in the Gemini app and oAI model for Search
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Mozilla’s new CEO says AI is coming to Firefox, but will remain a choice
description: Mozilla has appointed Anthony Enzor-DeMeo as its CEO as the Firefox developer scrambles to adapt in a rapidly changing browser market.
author: Ram Iyer

title: Google’s vibe-coding tool Opal comes to Gemini
description: The company on Wednesday said it is integrating the tool, which lets you build AI-powered mini apps, inside the Gemini web app, allowing users to create their own custom apps.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Skana Robotics helps fleets of underwater robots communicate with each other
description: Skana Robotics built a decision-making algorithm that helps unmanned vessels react and adapt to data from other vessels.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Amazon reportedly in talks to invest $10B in OpenAI as circular deals stay popular
description: Amazon is in early discussions to invest as much as $10 billion in OpenAI in a deal that would see the AI lab using the e-commerce giant's AI chips.
author: Ivan Mehta
